threads.thread_goal: Align on current journey map, key gaps, and overall pathway design.

messages.text: Team, I've completed the initial review for T1 and mapped the current client journey. I've also created a first draft of the new pathway overview in A1. The main goal is to create a more structured flow. Please take a look and share your thoughts on the proposed stages and the gaps I've highlighted.
Thanks. It looks ok. Where do we talk about their housing situation?

This is a helpful visual. I'm wondering about the handovers, especially from the social worker's assessment to us for the employment workshops. How do we make sure that's a warm and effective handover?

Good overview. I'd strongly recommend adding a formal health and wellbeing check-in point before a client starts a work placement. It's a high-stress moment, and we can prevent crises by screening for potential issues proactively. This should be a key part of the pathway.
Good question. Housing needs will be a core part of the holistic assessment in the first stage, which will be captured in the template for T2.

That's an excellent point, 14638. Let's build that in. So, incorporating that, how does this sound for the main stages: 1. Holistic Assessment, 2. Skills Building & Workshops, 3. Placement & Transition (with pre-placement wellbeing check), 4. In-Work Support. Can we agree on this structure?

I agree with 6627 on handovers. From a logistics side, the handover for moves is often a gap. We sometimes don't get the full context on a client's support needs, which makes the move more stressful for them. A clear protocol for that is key.
Yes, that structure for the pathway makes sense to me.

Valid point, 459543. It sounds like 'inter-team handovers' is a major theme. Based on the T1 review and this discussion, the top 3 gaps seem to be: 1) Inconsistent initial assessments, 2) Poor inter-team handovers (between all of us), and 3) Lack of structured follow-up after a client starts work. Shall we confirm these as the top priorities to address in the pilot design?
Yes, those three cover the biggest issues we see. Agree.
Agreed. That aligns with what I see from a health perspective too.
ok

Excellent. To summarize, we've made two key decisions. D1: We've agreed on the four main stages for the new pathway. D2: We've confirmed the top three priority gaps to address. I will update the pathway overview doc A1 to reflect this. Thanks, everyone.

threads.thread_goal: Finalise assessment, health screening, and safeguarding tools.

messages.text: Hi all, as per T2, I've uploaded a draft of the holistic assessment template to the drive. It's linked here as A2. Please can you review and provide feedback, especially 9716 and 14638.

Thanks, 8393. I've reviewed it and also drafted the health screening checklist A4 for T4. I've left comments in A2, mainly about strengthening the consent section to explicitly cover sharing information with health partners for referrals. We also need to ensure the triggers in A4 for clinical referral are unambiguous. The two documents must work together seamlessly.

Excellent points, 14638. The link between assessment and health screening is critical. 8393, please integrate those changes into A2. While you're doing that, I've drafted the safeguarding and incident reporting flow A7 for T9. The main challenge is defining clear thresholds for what constitutes a reportable incident. Feedback welcome.
Ok, I will work on updating A2 with the feedback.

The flow in A7 looks robust, 9716. The escalation path is clear. My only question is about implementation – we'll need a short, mandatory briefing for all staff, including movers, to ensure they understand their reporting duties under this protocol.

Completely agree. That briefing will be part of the micro-training sessions planned in T10. For now, can we agree on the flow as documented in A7? If so, we can approve the safeguarding protocol for the pilot.
I've updated the assessment template A2 now with the stronger consent section and the points from 14638.
Thanks, 8393. I've reviewed the new version of A2. It looks solid. The consent part is much clearer now. Are we all happy to approve this template for use in the pilot?
Yes, A2 and A4 are now well-aligned. I approve. I also agree with the safeguarding flow in A7.
I agree on the safeguarding flow as well.
Perfect. That's two decisions confirmed. D3: The holistic assessment template A2 is approved for pilot use. And D4: The safeguarding and incident reporting flow A7 is agreed. Great work, team.

threads.thread_goal: Shape the workshop programme and client-facing information pack.

messages.text: Hi team, for T3 I've drafted an outline for the employment readiness workshops. I've focused on practical skills. Let me know your thoughts.
what about a session on writing CVs?
That's a good point, it's currently under the 'Job Application Skills' session. Maybe I should make that title clearer so people know it's included.

This is a great start, 6627. To ensure accessibility, let's design activities that don't rely heavily on reading or writing. We could use role-playing for interviews and maybe picture-based exercises for workplace communication. I also think we should add a dedicated session on 'Knowing Your Rights at Work' to empower clients.
Those are really good ideas, 9716. I'll add a session on rights and rethink the activities to be more interactive and inclusive. Thanks!
here is the info pack for T7.

Thanks for sharing the draft of A8, 76106. We'll need to simplify the language quite a bit to meet accessibility standards. For example, instead of 'This pathway facilitates holistic progression toward sustainable employment outcomes', we should aim for something like 'We are here to help you find a job and feel good'. The goal is to make it easy for everyone to understand.
I can help with that. I've worked on plain-language guides before. I can take a pass at simplifying the text in A8.

That would be a great help, thank you 6627. Let's lock in the workshop structure then. How does this sound for the four core sessions: 1. My Skills & Goals, 2. Workplace Communication, 3. Job Searching & Applications, 4. My Rights at Work. Can we agree on these topics?
+1 from me, that's a solid structure.
ok
Great. D5: The four workshop topics are confirmed. 6627, once you've revised the info pack A8, please share it here for a final check.
Here is the updated client info pack A8. I've simplified the language and focused on a friendly, encouraging tone.
This is excellent, 6627. It's clear, respectful, and easy to understand. I'm happy to sign this off. D6: The client-facing information pack A8 is approved for distribution.

threads.thread_goal: Agree on logistics for moves, workplace transitions, and employer engagement.

messages.text: Morning all. I've drafted the safe relocation and workplace transition checklist A5 for T5. It covers pre-move checks with the client, steps to protect dignity during the move, and confirming essentials are set up at the new place. Ready for review when you are.

Thanks, 459543. This is very thorough. The section on 'confirming a safe and private space' is a fantastic addition from a safeguarding perspective. I have no changes, this looks ready to go. I propose we approve it.
Great, glad it works. Happy to get that locked in.
Okay, let's make it official. D7: The safe relocation and workplace transition checklist A5 is approved.

On a related note, for T11 I've been speaking to local employers. I have three who are confirmed and keen to be part of the pilot: 'Fresh Start Cafe', 'Community Cleaners Co-op', and 'Green Spaces Gardening'. I've put their details in a shared doc.
That's great news, 6627. Did you discuss our support model with them, to ensure they understand the clients may need extra support from us during the transition?
Yes, I explained the model and they are all on board. They all have some experience with supported employment, so they understand the approach.
what about the big supermarket?
I contacted them but their formal process is too slow for our pilot timeline. These three are confirmed and ready to start when we are.
Three solid, confirmed partners is a perfect start for a pilot. Let's proceed with these three. Does everyone agree?
Sounds good. Knowing the locations will help me plan logistics for the workplace transitions.
Yes, agreed.
Perfect. Decision made. D8: We will proceed with Fresh Start Cafe, Community Cleaners Co-op, and Green Spaces Gardening as our initial pilot employers.

threads.thread_goal: Set up tracking, evaluation, and team rituals for the pilot.

messages.text: Final stretch, team. Let's define how we'll track progress and learn from the pilot. I've drafted an evaluation plan for T12, and 6627 has created the outcome tracker A6 for T8. Please take a look.
The tracker A6 is intentionally simple. It covers workshop attendance, key milestones, and employment status. All client data is pseudonymised to protect privacy.

This is good. For the evaluation plan in T12, I suggest we add a simple client-reported wellbeing score. We could use a 1-5 scale and ask clients at the start, middle, and end of their journey. It would give us a valuable health-related outcome measure.

That's an excellent idea, 14638. It adds a crucial dimension. So, our key indicators would be: 1. Workshop attendance rate, 2. Pathway completion rate, 3. Employment placement rate, and 4. Client wellbeing score. Does that sound like the right set of indicators to track?
Works for me. Simple and clear.
Yes, I can easily add a column for the wellbeing score in A6.
Great. D9: We agree on those four key indicators for the pilot.

Now for staying in sync. Given the tight timeline, I propose we do a quick async standup in this channel on Mondays and Thursdays, and a 30-min video call on Wednesdays to resolve blockers. How does that sound for our rhythm?
+1. That cadence works with my shifts. I'm also ready to schedule the micro-trainings for T10 as soon as the final tools are stored.
Async is good for me as I'm often on the road. The weekly call is a good idea to make sure we're all connected.
The meeting schedule is fine.
Okay, that's settled. D10: We'll have async standups on Monday/Thursday and a 30-min sync checkpoint on Wednesdays. I'll set up the recurring calendar invite for the call. We're all set to launch.
